title: (RHBA-2018:1693) Fuse 7.0 images
portal_summary: Red Hat Fuse 7.0.0 release of 'Fuse on OpenShift' and 'Fuse Ignite' images.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.9|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Ignite images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Maven dependencies (provided through the Red Hat Maven repository)

Note the following component versions:
* Red Hat Fuse version: 7.0.0.fuse-000191-redhat-1
* BOM version: 3.0.11.fuse-000039-redhat-1
* Fabric8 Maven plug-in version: 3.5.33.fuse-000067-redhat-1
* Archetype version: 2.2.0.fuse-000092-redhat-2

The base URL for the image streams and templates in this release is:
https://github.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/tree/application-templates-2.1.fuse-000081-redhat-4

To install the image streams, log in to OpenShift as an administrator and enter the following command:

oc create -n openshift -f \
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-000081-redhat-4/fis-image-streams.json

And to install the templates, enter the following command:

for template in eap-camel-amq-template.json \
 eap-camel-cdi-template.json \
 eap-camel-cxf-jaxrs-template.json \
 eap-camel-cxf-jaxws-template.json \
 eap-camel-jpa-template.json \
 karaf-camel-amq-template.json \
 karaf-camel-log-template.json \
 karaf-camel-rest-sql-template.json \
 karaf-cxf-rest-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-amq-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-config-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-drools-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-infinispan-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-teiid-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-xml-template.json \
 spring-boot-cxf-jaxrs-template.json \
 spring-boot-cxf-jaxws-template.json ;
 do
 oc create -n openshift -f \
 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-000081-redhat-4/quickstarts/${template}
 done
portal_description: This advisory makes available the images for Fuse on OpenShift (previously called Fuse Integration Services) and Fuse Ignite for Red Hat Fuse 7.0.0 GA.
